findings.fact: DagRunner holds claimInputForTask/claimDiscrete until finally; claimContinuous rejects when discrete is nonzero. A naive child motor node would conflict with its own parent reservation.
findings.decision: Atomic delegated episode ownership bound to running parent task; confirmed neutral before return; preserve uncertainty fence.

findings.fact: Current native touch uses one pointer; Android KeyEvent bypasses Windows emulator keymapping.
findings.decision: Versioned per-game controls profile plus multi-pointer or verified Android gamepad; no Windows focus-dependent injection baseline.

findings.fact: 5 Hz gives a 200 ms observation period. Held controls may persist between updates. This does not prove route quality or age at application.
findings.decision: Separate observation, prediction horizon and local execution; evaluate 2/5/10/20 Hz at matched routes and speed.

findings.fact: Released Minecraft/ViZDoom checkpoints have game-state/proprio inputs and domain-specific action spaces. Published H200 benchmark is not Black Russia/consumer-GPU fleet evidence.
findings.decision: Research alternative, not a drop-in APK visual policy.

findings.fact: One encoder serves peers; weakest fresh bitrate allocation governs source. Sampling decoded frames at 5 Hz does not lower 60 Hz decoding work.
findings.decision: Measure AI-only low-FPS mode versus full decoding/shared-viewer policy or separate substream.

findings.fact: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash exists with native vision, but active parameter count is not resident model size; advertised mixed-format safetensors exceed 510 decimal GB.
findings.decision: Optional external planner; no ordinary single-GPU local motor capacity assumed.

findings.fact: No reproducible ready-made Black Russia plus Sphere APK plus 50x5Hz package was found in reviewed sources. Author demos and domain benchmarks are catalogued separately.
findings.decision: Select models by matched route evaluation, preserve negative results and stage gates.
